docEdit.before: Blotato API and MCP require a paid subscription. Go to Settings > API and click "Generate API Key" to activate your paid subscription.
docEdit.after: Check the Blotato account used during authorization and its paid-access state, record the exact error, and follow the MCP OAuth checks. Generating an API key during a trial starts billing, so do not use it as an automatic fix.
